  SELECT oi.category, strftime(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month_key, SUM(oi.amount) AS revenue

results.question: What was the month-over-month revenue growth percentage?
results.gold_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(oi.amount) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT
  month,
  revenue,
  (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))
    / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) * 100 AS mom_growth_pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month
results.agent_sql:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT strftime(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(oi.amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY month) SELECT month, revenue, (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) * 100 AS mom_growth FROM monthly_revenue ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1000
